concurrency.about.content: How many project containers may run at once, and how much memory each may use.
concurrency.about.label: About concurrency
concurrency.adminOnly: Concurrency settings are managed by the Admin. You don't have access to this page.
concurrency.backend.daytonaNote: containers run on Daytona, so the budget below is a spend limit rather than a share of this machine. Daytona allows at most 8 GB per sandbox and allocates 10 GB of disk to each, and your account has a total disk quota across all sandboxes - that quota is often what limits how many run at once, whatever the budget allows.
concurrency.backend.dockerNote: containers share this machine, so the budget below is a share of its RAM and swap.
concurrency.backend.label: Containers run on:
concurrency.diskSize.label: Disk per container (GB)
concurrency.diskSize.point.allocation: The disk each project container is given for its checkouts, dependencies and build output.
concurrency.diskSize.point.managed: Applies where the container service allocates a filesystem per container. On a local container service a container’s workspace has your whole disk behind it, so there is nothing to allocate.
concurrency.diskSize.point.override: Projects that need more can override it on their own Containers page.
concurrency.diskSize.point.range: Whole number from {min} to {max}. Defaults to {default}.
concurrency.diskSize.point.recycle: A container that fills most of its allocation is replaced rather than reused, so a run never runs out of space partway through.
concurrency.intro: Containers start on demand when an agent run or the assistant needs one, and stop after sitting idle. These limits bound what a burst of agent activity can take on this machine.
concurrency.memoryBudget.formulaAuto: Automatic: {ram} GB RAM + {swap} GB swap = {total} GB, less {reserved} GB for the system = {usable} GB.
concurrency.memoryBudget.formulaManaged: Automatic: {value} GB. Containers run on the provider, not on this machine, so this is a spend guard rather than a share of host memory - raise it when you want more running at once.
concurrency.memoryBudget.formulaSet: Set explicitly. The automatic value for this host would be {value} GB.
concurrency.memoryBudget.label: Total container memory
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.automatic: On automatic, and only for a local container service, Hezo starts from this machine’s memory plus swap and sets aside {reserved} GB for the system. A managed service gets a flat default instead.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.queue: The chatbox assistant always runs a container, and is never queued behind agent runs.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.range: Whole number of GB from {min} to {max}.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.scope: Total memory all containers may use at once.
concurrency.memoryBudget.split: {task} GB for task runs, {chat} GB held back for the assistant.
concurrency.ramCap.label: RAM cap per container (GB)
concurrency.ramCap.point.divisor: A higher cap means each container takes a bigger share of the budget above, so fewer run at once.
concurrency.ramCap.point.limit: The memory limit applied to every project container.
concurrency.ramCap.point.overCap: A container that grows past the cap is stopped instead of taking down the server.

setup.masterKey.lifecycleDescription: Keep this key handy so you can unlock Hezo in your browser. New Hezo processes start locked by default. A reboot, crash, or direct service restart needs a browser unlock unless that startup receives one-shot --master-key or HEZO_MASTER_KEY input.
